Full job description
The Gilded Gull Taphouse is a fictional craft beer pub on the harbour. We're hiring a Server/Bartender for busy evening and weekend shifts. You'll take orders, pour draft beer and mix simple cocktails, run food, and handle payments on our Lightspeed POS. You must have your Serving It Right certificate before your first shift and be 19 or older. Bartending experience is a bonus; we will train the right person on our cocktail list.

Job Types: Part-time, Casual

Pay: $17.40 per hour

Expected hours: 15 – 25 per week

Benefits:
• Discounted or free food
• Flexible schedule

Supplemental pay types:
• Tips

Ability to commute/relocate:
• Victoria, BC: reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (required)

Experience:
• serving: 1 year (preferred)

Language:
• English (required)

Licence/Certification:
• Serving It Right (required)

Work Location: In person
